122: This applies to a matter that will not be revealed - That means to say, we certainly follow ownership of the land, however this only applies to situation that will never (ever) be clarified, like that case [of rental in a leap year] where we are in doubt whether the first statement [12 gold coins for a year] is the applicable one, or whether the latter expression [1 dinar per month] is the applicable one:
But here the matter will be revealed - Ultimately when they bring the witness on the document to testify:

And we do not trouble the Court to (convene) twice - Perhaps the law will determine it belongs to the lender, and if we (now) extract from his possession, we will be required to retract and (re)claim from the borrower in the future:
